selector.rationale: Patient's history of biopsy-proven juvenile dermatomyositis and current symptoms such as difficulty picking up her child and climbing stairs, along with physical examination findings like violaceous to erythematous patches on the joints, support the diagnosis of dermatomyositis.

rejected.label: Psoriasis
rejected.why: Although the patient has a history of psoriasis, the current symptoms and physical examination findings are more consistent with a flare of dermatomyositis.
